//: Used only by `pnpm build` (see typescript.tsconfigPath in next.config.ts). Differs from tsconfig.json in two ways. (1) It ignores .next/dev, the route types `next dev` generates — those include the dev-only /admin routes and clash with the production route map. (2) It ignores the writing desk itself. Those files are not routes in a production build, so type-checking them would only force their dev-only dependencies (CodeMirror) to be installed on the deploy machine. They are still fully checked in development via tsconfig.json.
